extras: The plugin includes advanced performance optimizations like WebP thumbnails and lazy loading, and ensures cover assignments persist across folder renames.
intentEvidence: Since I could not find an existing plugin that matched exactly what I wanted, I used GPT to help turn the idea into a working plugin.
motivation: I built Folder Cover Wall with the help of GPT because I wanted a more visual and expressive way to browse folders — something closer to the polished, cover-based folder experience found in apps like Craft.
problem: Standard folder lists lack a visual, expressive interface for browsing and navigating complex folder structures.
summary: Folder Cover Wall transforms the left sidebar into a visual browser, displaying folders as large cover cards using custom or automatic images.
